versions.content:
[SWS_PHM_00244] NoSupervision on Start of Process
⌈
On start of the
process in the new Function Group State, if NoSupervision is configured for a Supervised Entity Instance corresponding to the process in the Supervi-
sion Mode corresponding to the new Function Group State, then no Supervi-
sion (no Alive Supervision, Deadline Supervision or Logical Supervi-
sion) shall be performed for the Supervised Entity Instance in the Supervision
Mode corresponding to new Function Group State.
⌋
